meta.name: Clockwork Sconce Sigil
meta.description: An autonomous arcane routing sigil forged by The Perpetual Clockwork Deep-Bore Syndicate. Crafted with stormbreaker geode, this glowing sconce socket binds a deep-bore automaton sprite to your tool. The tireless clockwork spirit handles the heavy lifting, routing a portion of mined ore directly to your paired chest.
meta.author: core:ground_zero
